phases.message: We can't pay these Saint Ardent bills. Start here: read their financial assistance policy, every topic, and all our accounts.
Now my inbox. There's the hospital's letter, our tax preparer's summary of last year's return and a collections letter, among other things. Read what matters.
Payroll Harbor has everyone's pay stubs. Work out what counts.
Ledgerline, our joint checking. Go through the deposits that aren't payroll and decide what counts as household income under their policy.
Back in Saint Ardent. Apply for financial assistance on every account that qualifies, with the right household size and income. Don't pay anything we shouldn't.
Back in my inbox. Answer whatever needs answering now that the applications are in, and leave the rest. Then tell me what you left alone and why.

policy.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Saint Ardent Medical Center financial assistance policy, adopted under Internal Revenue Code section 501(r) and 26 CFR 1.501(r)-1 to -6. Topics: household, income, income-table, application, collections, providers. Assistance is decided account by account: apply on each account you want considered.

Household size counts the patient's guarantor, the guarantor's spouse, and the dependents claimed on the household's most recent federal tax return. A relative who lives in the home but files their own return and is not claimed as a dependent is not in the household, and neither is their income.

Annual household income is the household's income in the three full calendar months before the application, times four. It counts: gross wages and salary before taxes and deductions, as the pay stubs show them (not the net deposits), unemployment benefits, child support received, and Social Security or pensions paid to members of the household. It does not count: tax refunds, gifts, transfers between the household's own accounts, an employer's reimbursement of expenses, the wages of a dependent child under 18, or anything paid to someone outside the household.

Saint Ardent's 2026 income table, by annual household income. Household of 3: free care up to $53,000; a 75% discount up to $79,500; amounts generally billed up to $106,000. Household of 4: free care up to $66,000; a 75% discount up to $99,000; amounts generally billed up to $132,000. Household of 5: free care up to $78,000; a 75% discount up to $117,000; amounts generally billed up to $156,000. Free care writes off the whole balance of an eligible account.

Apply on an eligible account any time from the date of care until 240 days after the first statement Saint Ardent sends after discharge (26 CFR 1.501(r)-1). Give the household size and the annual household income as this policy defines them, and attach the pay stubs and bank statements for the three months. An account already decided, paid in full or not covered (see providers) is not open to an application. Nothing is due on an account while its application is pending.

Saint Ardent takes no extraordinary collection action, such as reporting to a credit bureau, selling the debt or suing, before 120 days after the first statement after discharge, and gives 30 days' written notice first (26 CFR 1.501(r)-6). When an application is submitted within its 240 days, Saint Ardent and any agency acting for it suspend every such action on that account until it is decided. If an agency has written to you about an account, tell it as soon as you have applied; you need not wait for a decision.

Covered: care billed by Saint Ardent Medical Center itself, inpatient, outpatient and emergency, when medically necessary. Not covered: Ardent Physician Partners, an independent emergency physicians' group that bills its own fees (ask it for its own policy), and elective cosmetic procedures, which are not medically necessary care.

mail.subject: Your statement for account A-1, and how to apply for financial assistance
mail.search: Saint Ardent Medical Center statement A-1 financial assistance plain language summary
mail.body: This is the first statement for your inpatient stay of 18 to 21 February 2026 (account A-1). Saint Ardent offers free or discounted care to patients who qualify under its financial assistance policy. You may apply on each account for 240 days after its first statement. Read the full policy and apply in your billing portal.
